title: A Stochastic Implicit Proximal Point Algorithm for Solving Linearly Constrained Stochastic Minimax Problems
summary: This paper presents a novel approach to solving large-scale minimax problems with nonsmooth regularizers. We propose a stochastic implicit proximal point algorithm with variance reduction techniques where stochastic oracles are selected in two cases -- with or without replacement. The semismooth Newton methods with Armijo line search is used to solve the implicit proximal point update subproblem in each iteration.
